crossRefs.note: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you, because of your righteous ordinances.
God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary…
when I remember you on my bed, and think about you in the night watches.
How precious to me are your thoughts, God! How vast is their sum!
If I would count them, they are more in number than the sand. When I wake up, I am still with you.
Arise, cry out in the night, at the beginning of the watches! Pour out your heart like water before the face of the…
In these days, he went out to the mountain to pray, and he continued all night in prayer to God.

translations.web: My eyes stay open through the night watches, that I might meditate on your word.
translations.bsb: My eyes anticipate the watches of night, that I may meditate on Your word.
translations.kjv: Mine eyes prevent the night watches, that I might meditate in thy word.
translations.asv: Mine eyes anticipated the night-watches, That I might meditate on thy word.
